description: Reconstruction of Cell Systems 2020 Figure 2F from preserved notebook statistics: Miniprotein protease stability score correlation across 4 topologies and 4 design rounds.
notes: Reconstructs published statistics from Notebook 06 Cell 53 and Notebook 07 Cell 102. Raw per-design network score tensors were not preserved in git repository. Highlights EEHEE Round 4 negative correlation exception where Rosetta talaris2013 rho ~ -0.40 and ProteinSolver rho ~ -0.14.
